## Natural history notes

A large bird grasshopper characterized by its long body, strong hind legs, brown to rusty-brown coloration, and long wings that allow strong flight. In Florida, it is found in open and semi-open habitats such as pine flatwoods, scrub, prairies, fields, roadsides, forest edges, and disturbed areas with grasses, shrubs, and low vegetation. It feeds on leaves and other plant material, usually resting on vegetation or the ground and escaping disturbance with powerful jumps followed by short flights.
